purpose: Executable repository-governance contract for RMD version changes and public scientific-core releases. A version bump must be atomic across package metadata, citation metadata, user-facing metadata, changelog and GitHub release/tag state. Scientific model maturity is tracked separately from artifact version.

current_public_release.release_name: v0.2.0 — Structural review and reproducibility milestone

versioning_basis.rationale: v0.2.0 remains an immutable published snapshot. Main now contains substantive post-release scientific-governance progress, including promotion of aggregate reference-mode observability to 10/10 and additional Accounting Spine source-boundary/reopen diagnostics, but no new canonical multi-instrument Accounting Spine completion, behavioural activation, calibration authorization or validated-model milestone that requires an immediate release. The post-release work remains Unreleased until a coherent v0.3.0 milestone is intentionally prepared.
versioning_basis.next_candidate_rationale: The default next substantive 0.x scientific-core milestone is 0.3.0. It should package a coherent post-v0.2.0 scientific boundary rather than being triggered by individual diagnostics alone. A narrowly scoped corrective release may instead use 0.2.1 when that classification is accurate.

release_preparation.release_name: v0.2.0 — Structural review and reproducibility milestone

atomic_repository_surfaces.rule: Must equal the actual public release date when a release is published.
The Unreleased material included in the release must move under the new version/date heading.
Must be advanced atomically with the release preparation and finalized after publication.
Create a new immutable release-notes file for each public version; do not rewrite an older version file to describe newer work.

external_release_surfaces.rule: Create v<version> at the exact reviewed release commit; never move a published release tag to rewrite history.
Publish from the same v<version> tag and include release notes that state the current scientific maturity and non-claims.

pre_publish_gates: CITATION.cff release date and CHANGELOG release date agree with the intended publication date.
A versioned `releases/v<version>.md` file exists and matches the intended release version and scientific boundary.
Scientific CI and all required accounting/materialization audits are green on the exact release commit.
Release notes preserve current scientific boundaries and do not imply validated behavioural closure, causal identification or model completion unless those states are actually authorized.
No previously published version/tag is mutated to contain new code or scientific artifacts.
post_publish_verification: Git tag points to the exact reviewed release commit.
GitHub Release uses the same tag and version.
Repository version, package version, README badge, CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG remain synchronized.
The release page and CITATION metadata describe the same public artifact.
